dimensions.note: No settings, no secrets, no vault fields. GitHub reads use the environment's gh sign-in (the spec assumes gh is signed in); nothing is stored or logged from it.

run logs info on entry ("Checking {repository} on {where}") and on completion ("{answer}") with structured props; a failed SPDX lookup or missing git is a warning with {repository} and {error}. No tokens or secret values are logged. Tested by "run logs what it checks and what it found" and the two warning tests.

behaviour.run finishes before writeResource, so a failure writes nothing. gh failures other than 404 throw with gh's stderr; a missing repo throws "GitHub has no repository X that gh can see" (confirmed live); bad repo and missing path throw with the value. The optional SPDX lookup for a local repo is caught narrowly and logged. Minor: a JSON.parse failure or gh missing from PATH on a named check surfaces Deno's raw error without the repo in it.

39 tests pass. Since 2026.10.30.1 one test is added: the licence recipe's empty is exactly "No licence file found.", the agreed whenEmpty of Capture request #11 (puddleworks-capture#28). The existing tests still cover yes/no, every licence name form, sub-root and directory non-matches, worktree .git file, empty and missing repos, bad input, non-git dir, missing path, the workflows and the recipe tag, with gh/git stubbed. Still untested: ssh:// and git@ forms of the repo argument, and the non-array listing branch.
Read-only: no create or delete. Each run writes a new version of the one result resource; interruption leaves nothing partial. Live runs left git status unchanged.

Unchanged GitHub reads: GETs only via gh api (contents, license, repo). The recipe tag gains "empty":"No licence file found.", an optional puddlerouterRecipe field the router already reads; pattern, inputs, each and template are unchanged, so existing phrasings answer the same way. Capture 2026.11.10.1 compares this empty with the agreed whenEmpty byte for byte.
Deno.Command(...).output() collects and closes both pipes; readDir iterators run to completion; no temp files or cloud resources are created. Tests remove their temp dirs in finally.

Package files are unchanged apart from the recipe tag and the version: the model, two workflows, README.md and LICENSE (MIT, puddle-works). No IPs, internal hostnames, account IDs or personal details; fixtures use acme/tool and public puddle-works repos.

GlobalArgsSchema, RunArgsSchema, LicenceSchema and ResultSchema are plain z.object with no passthrough; checked enum and nullable fields are explicit. Mechanical checks: the one writeResource("result", "result", {args, items, ranAt}) matches ResultSchema field for field, every Licence return sets all seven fields with real values, no placeholders, no truncation.
The result resource sets lifetime infinite and garbageCollection 20, reasonable for a small check history.
A read-only check with one run method, not a CRUD lifecycle model.
No mutating method; run only reads the working tree and GitHub.
One spec, one method, one fixed instance name "result"; no collisions.
No method reads stored state back.

The model moves from 2026.10.30.1 to 2026.11.11.1 with a no-op upgrades entry, so an existing instance (the desk has one) has its typeVersion moved along; the global arguments and the result schema are unchanged, so no attribute needs migrating.
